title: Watermelon Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++ Ad
hook: Metro commute leaving your face a greasy, white mess? Let's fix that.

frames.visual: Ananya looking at her phone screen in the auto-rickshaw, wiping sweat and squinting at a greasy face in front camera.
frames.scene_prompt: Inside an auto-rickshaw in Delhi, hazy morning light, urban street blurred in background, vibrant warm tones.

frames.visual: She holds up the Watermelon Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++ tube, smiling brightly as the sunlight hits.
frames.scene_prompt: Bright sunny college campus courtyard, lush green trees, youthful aesthetic, cinematic lighting.

frames.visual: Dabbing lightweight pink watermelon gel onto her cheek, blending it instantly with zero effort.
frames.voiceover: It feels super light and airy [m:net:dotandkey:texture|watermelon-cooling-spf-50-face-sunscreen] [r:dotandkey:0ca49bc1-d543-4921-86db-474b939fbd86].
frames.scene_prompt: Close-up of clean vanity setup with fresh watermelon slices and dewy morning light.

frames.visual: Touching her smooth, non-greasy cheek and smiling at the camera, glowing skin check.
frames.voiceover: No grease, no stickiness, just pure glow [m:net:dotandkey:finish|watermelon-cooling-spf-50-face-sunscreen] [r:dotandkey:94188a46-dc7e-4294-835f-52578244d110].
frames.scene_prompt: A sunny balcony with potted plants, soft natural daylight framing a happy college student.

frames.visual: Applying makeup smoothly right over the SPF layer, showing zero pilling.
frames.voiceover: Layers like a dream under makeup [m:net:dotandkey:makeup_pilling|watermelon-cooling-spf-50-face-sunscreen] [r:dotandkey:3b4f4768-02ff-49da-b323-f0153db4f8a0].
frames.scene_prompt: Clean aesthetic vanity table with pastel makeup brushes and soft morning sun rays.

frames.visual: The Watermelon Sunscreen tube is displayed centrally on a pink pedestal surrounded by fresh watermelon chunks with price ₹387 on screen.
frames.scene_prompt: Minimalist pink studio background with juicy watermelons and clean aesthetic lighting.

video_concept: A high-energy, relatable Gen-Z aesthetic video following a college commuter through a bustling city day. Vibrant pink and green watermelon color palettes pop against sun-kissed outdoor scenes, highlighting effortless skin texture and lightweight sun protection.
music_mood: Upbeat indie-pop with playful fruit-stand percussion and breezy summer vibes.
